families.overview: Cutler-Hammer/Eaton (Canada) retrofit interiors for installation into existing panelboard enclosures; P1R 240 Vac max, P2R 347/600 Vac max. Mains: lugs (100/225/400 A), BAB (P1R) or GBH/GHB (P2R) 60-100 A, or E/F-frame 60-225 A.

bus_joint_torque.value: Bus bar connections (Cu or Al): #10 30 lb-in (2.5 lb-ft, 3.4 N-m); 1/4 in 65 lb-in (5.4 lb-ft, 7.3 N-m); 5/16 in 130 lb-in (10.8 lb-ft, 14.7 N-m); 3/8 in 240 lb-in (20 lb-ft, 27.1 N-m); 1/2 in 600 lb-in (50 lb-ft, 67.8 N-m)
bus_joint_torque.page: IL01417001E Appendix Table 2 (p.13); PUB50895 Appendix Table 4

mounting.value: Interior mounted with #10-32 hardware: drill and tap 10-32 holes at minimum 8 mounting locations in back of existing enclosure; depth-adjustment bracket #10-32 screws torqued to 24 in-lb; one existing mounting stud or supplied bonding wire/lug used to bond chassis to enclosure.

minimum_enclosure.value: P1RL/P1RB minimum enclosure (H x W x D, in): lug 100 A 18/30/42 ckt 19.5/26.5/33.5 x 14.25 x 4.5; lug 225 A 22/28/34 x 14.25 x 4.5; BAB main 60-100 A 19.5/26.5/33.5 x 14.25 x 4.5; E/F-frame main 60-225 A 30/36/42 x 14.25 x 4.5; lug 400 A 24-42 ckt 48 x 20.0 x 5.75. P2RL/P2RB same heights, depth 4.75 in (400 A 5.75 in), GBH/GHB main 60-100 A.

leads.topic: Eaton SPX0361126 project O&M manual (585 pp) on ManualsLib
leads.detail: ManualsLib manual 1538842 'Eaton Pow-R-Line SPX0361126' compiles IM01500001E (2011), Pow-R-Line panelboard renewal parts (Feb 2009) and switchboard unit data incl. 'Circuit Breaker Mounting Bolt Drilling Plan' (p.413) and 'Branch Devices' (p.363). Curl/manualzz blocked (403); WebFetch works page by page.
Fastener torque values for 3FQS live on agency label 3A1064 (not reproduced in E3A1071). Field photo of label needed.
Eaton web SKU pages state 'Amperage Rating 140A max' for KPRL3ABA*/KPRL3AGB*/KPRL3AFD* while catalogue holds RP01400001E-derived 100 A/150 A device limits. Resolve with kit label/IL.
